info.name: Blend Odoo 19 - Bunbastic STG - Complete HTTP API
info.description: Core-backed Blend HTTP contract for bunbastic STG. This collection uses the Blend connection's Odoo User login method: POST /api/login with email/password returns access_token, then inbound requests use it as a Bearer token. The Odoo User selected on the connection is admin; the supplied test password is admin. The connection must pass Test Connection and be Connected before login. Run GET Branches to populate branch_id and brand_id; verify product 32 with GET Menu by Product ID before placing an order. The example for product 32 uses the local dump price 23.00 = subtotal 20.00 + VAT 3.00; update amounts if the STG menu, pricelist, or taxes differ. Configure a branch mapping, active menu pricelist, POS session, and keeta/cash payment mapping before enabling order writes. Mutating requests are skipped by default; explicitly set enable_orders, enable_webhooks, or enable_outbound_examples to true for their folders. Outbound webhook examples target Blend-owned URLs and are not inbound Odoo tests.

item.name: 00 - Authorization (Required)

item.name: 02 - Blend calls Manual POS APIs (Required)
item.description: الـManual POS endpoints المنشورة في Blend: GET /api/menu، GET /api/branches، POST /api/orders، PUT /api/order/update.

item.name: 01 - Get Branches

exec: pm.test('Blend branches array is available', function () { pm.expect(body.branches).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });
const selected = branches.find(b => String(b.id) === preferred) || branches.find(b => b.status === true) || branches[0];

pm.test('Selected branch has Blend IDs', function () { pm.expect(selected).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(String(selected.id)).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(String(selected.brand_id || '')).to.not.be.empty; });
pm.test('Selected Blend branch is available', function () { pm.expect(selected.status).to.eql(true); });

item.description: Run first with a Blend Bearer token. Selects the configured branch if present, otherwise an available branch, and saves the remote branch_id and brand_id. POS config ID 1 is not a substitute.

item.name: 02 - Get Menu Page 1

exec: pm.test('page contains at most per products', function () { const products = body.categories.flatMap((category) => category.products || []); pm.expect(products.length).to.be.at.most(Number(pm.request.url.query.get('per') || 25)); });

pm.test('pagination describes page range', function () { const pagination = body.pagination; pm.expect(pagination.per).to.eql(Number(pm.request.url.query.get('per') || 25)); pm.expect(pagination.current).to.eql(Number(pm.request.url.query.get('page') || 1)); pm.expect(pagination.from).to.eql(pagination.total ? 1 : 0); pm.expect(pagination.to).to.eql(pagination.total); });

pm.test('all modifier maximums are positive', function () { const groups = body.categories.flatMap((category) => category.products || []).flatMap((product) => product.modifier_groups || []); groups.forEach((group) => { pm.expect(group.max_selection, 'max_selection for group ' + group.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); }); });

request.description: يرجع أول 25 منتجًا بحد أقصى، مجمعة حسب التصنيف. لجلب الباقي غيّر page إلى 2 ثم 3 حتى pagination.total. pagination.from و pagination.to هما أول وآخر رقم صفحة، و current رقم الصفحة الحالية.

item.description: Requires one authorized Blend connection with an active Menu Pricelist. Prices and product IDs are the API source of truth.

item.name: 03 - Get Menu by Product ID

exec: pm.test('filtered product exists and has a numeric ID', function () { const products = body.categories.flatMap((category) => category.products || []); const product = products.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(pm.variables.get('item_id'))); pm.expect(product, 'filtered product id').to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(product.id).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('all modifier maximums are positive', function () { const groups = body.categories.flatMap((category) => category.products || []).flatMap((product) => product.modifier_groups || []); groups.forEach((group) => { pm.expect(group.max_selection, 'max_selection for group ' + group.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); }); });

if (selectedProduct) { const group = (selectedProduct.modifier_groups || []).find(entry => (entry.modifiers || []).some(option => option.status)); if (group) { pm.collectionVariables.set('modifier_group_id', String(group.id)); const option = group.modifiers.find(entry => entry.status); pm.collectionVariables.set('modifier_id', String(option.id)); } }

pm.test('Example price matches STG menu', function () { pm.expect(selectedProduct, 'product in Blend menu').to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Number(selectedProduct.price)).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('order_total'))); });

pm.test('Example item available in selected branch', function () { pm.expect(((selectedProduct && selectedProduct.available_branches) || []).some(entry => String(entry.branch_id) === String(pm.variables.get('branch_id')) && entry.is_stock === true)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 05 - Create Keeta cash test order in POS

exec: ['branch_id', 'brand_id', 'item_id', 'odoo_inbound_token'].forEach(k => { if (!pm.variables.get(k)) { throw new Error('Set ' + k + ' after GET Branches / GET Menu'); } });

if (Math.abs(Number(pm.variables.get('order_subtotal')) + Number(pm.variables.get('order_tax')) - Number(pm.variables.get('order_total'))) > 0.001) { throw new Error('Order subtotal + tax must equal total'); }
pm.test('Blend order created: ' + pm.variables.get('aggregator_order_id'), function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 08 - Ninja payload on Bunbastic STG
item.description: Ninja order with the supplied financial amounts unchanged. Product IDs 859/851 from the original database map to STG products 32/35. Original remote branch/brand IDs 1300024/1300011 do not exist on STG, so this request uses STG Blend branch_id/brand_id 1/1. The request always runs in a collection run. It requires the Blend included-VAT fix on the target server before it can create a 141.40 POS order with 18.44 VAT.

exec: pm.test('success=true', function () { pm.expect(body.success, body.message || 'Blend rejected the order').to.eql(true); });

item.name: B - Unified Outbound Webhook (Odoo to Blend)
item.description: All four events POST their complete JSON payload to blend_outbound_webhook_url. Set it to the URL supplied by Blend. Use blend_outbound_token only if Blend requires Bearer authentication; it is not the Odoo login token. Legacy order_created remains separate.
